t: The LAP Weyburn outdoor LED floodlight in white is a robust lighting solution designed for reliable exterior illumination. This 10W, 1000 lumen floodlight provides a bright white light, making it ideal for enhancing security around commercial buildings, workshops, and domestic properties. It features an integrated PIR sensor with adjustable sensitivity, time, and lux settings, ensuring efficient motion detection. Constructed with a durable die-cast aluminium body and an IP65 rating, this floodlight is built to withstand outdoor conditions. The adjustable tilting head allows for precise light direction, and the long-lasting integrated LED offers 30,000 hours of maintenance-free operation.
b: Pre-Wired 0.75m Cable for Quick & Easy Installation
